notes.title: Rebalancing to make the game more enjoyable.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I made some adjustments to the game balancing.
My intention was to make the game as enjoyable as possible, which has always been my initial idea. However, the game was too difficult. Now, the small asteroids will not cause damage to the ship. I aimed to make the goal of achieving the highest score possible in the game more enjoyable.
I hope you can have more fun after this game rebalancing.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: A new game mode. That I called Black Hole!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

In recent weeks I worked on an update to the Super Asteroids.
With your feedback I created a new game mode! That I called Black Hole!

"When trying to launch the gravitational bomb something wrong happened! The gravitational bomb collapsed into a kind of singularity.
Your ship and everything around it sucked into the black hole.
Now you need to survive and find a way out! "

Black Hole is a Hardcore mode!
Your weapons are more powerful. But the behaviors of the asteroids are also more difficult to predict. 

Now you need to survive for 30 minutes and stick your highest score in the new game mode.

https://youtu.be/ikdZETgn5rE
Thank you very much for your attention.
Best Regards,
Erick Azevedo

notes.title: Super Asteroids is an arcade game. Inspired on the 80's classics!
notes.notes:
Super Asteroids is an arcade game. Inspired on the classic 80's shoot' em ups.
With a refined gameplay! Destroying thousands of asteroids becomes a pleasurable mission!

Stay alive and collect power ups to destroy as many asteroids as possible.
Make your highest score to put your name among the best players around the world.
Super Asteroides reserves a final surprise for the most skillful players.

We are launching our game.
We would like to count on you for our disclosure, with a community feedback we will keep on updating and refining our Super Asteroids.
https://youtu.be/pe_xi0IHPcc
Thank you very much for your attention.
Best regards,
Erick Azevedo

http://store.steampowered.com/app/788190/SUPER_ASTEROIDS/
https://www.facebook.com/SuperAsteroids/
